snippet.title: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929570/General_Tactics_An_Shi_Rebellion

In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Liyun, tom
📚 Publisher: Liyun, tom
📅 Release Date: Oct 27, 2026
🎯 Genre: Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
